## Professional Summary
David Morales Vega is a Solutions Architect and Technical Lead from Oruro, Bolivia, with over 8 years of experience designing scalable digital ecosystems. He holds a unique dual profile as both a Systems Engineer and a Lawyer, positioning him as a Legal-Tech expert in Bolivia. He specializes in Angular, NestJS, microservices architecture, hexagonal architecture, DDD (Domain-Driven Design), artificial intelligence (AI/ML/Data Science), and technical team leadership. He is the founder of BeMoreX, a digital innovation and technology agency.

## Expertise Areas
- Software Architecture (Microservices, Hexagonal, DDD, CQRS, EDA)
- Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (Machine Learning, LLMs/Gemini, vector search, OCR/computer vision)
- Frontend Development (Angular, Next.js, React, Flutter)
- Backend Development (NestJS, Node.js, Spring Boot, Laravel)
- Cloud & DevOps (Docker, Podman, Firebase, Cloudflare, CI/CD)
- Technical Leadership & Team Management
- Legal-Tech (intersection of law and technology)
- Agile Methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, XP)
